mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT v.object_key FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted' AND v.object_key IN #{objectKey}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted' LIMIT 1 )
SELECT v.object_key FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id WHERE d.status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
